title: Sancta Maria, succurre miseris (London 19583) (Richafort)
desc: Jean Richafort, Sancta Maria, succurre miseris (London 19583). 1 voices (Altus), each on its own staff. Source: London 19583. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
